## The four defects are fixed, and I verified each rather than trusting the master's log

The master kept round-1 backups; diffing them against the shipped fragments shows the change set is **exactly** the four fixes and nothing else — two lines in `p1.tex`, two hunks in `p2.tex`. `final/` is still byte-identical to the worker output dirs.

- **D1.1 (major) — resolved.** `p2python` now has `breakindent=2em, columns=fullflexible, keepspaces=true`. Re-rendered p.8: the Q3 listing typesets as `class HybridGTLayer(nn.Module):` / `self.norm_ffn` / `__init__`, matching Q1 and Q2, and **no line wraps at all** now — both column-0 continuations are gone. I lifted the listing back out of the shipped PDF with `pdftotext -layout` and `ast.parse`d it: 48 lines, parses as Python.
- **D1.2 — resolved.** Now "inside the 0.0200 seed spread of the full-attention row". I checked the premise: that row's seeds are 0.5496 / 0.5651 / 0.5696, max − min = 0.0200, and 0.0119 < 0.0200. True premise, same hedged conclusion.
- **D1.3 — resolved.** Table 4's caption now states the baselines were re-measured, names the gaps and bounds them by the 0.009 noise. Both subtractions check out (0.0083, 0.0007), and the 0.009 figure is itself real — three repeats of one unchanged configuration in `logs_det/` spread 0.0087.
- **D1.4 — resolved.** "constant" → "trivial", now consistent with the code comment and the surrounding text.

## Regressions: none

All 207 printed listing lines are still verbatim in the sources that produced the logs — **0 differ**, so no code or number moved. Compile is unchanged: 9 pages, no undefined refs, the same single 2.56 pt overfull box, and `build/compile/main.pdf` md5-matches the shipped PDF so the log is this build's. I image-diffed all nine pages: 2, 3, 4, 8, 9 changed — 8 and 9 are the fixes, 2 is the reworded sentences, 3 and 4 only the two-line reflow they cause. I re-read all five; margins, listings and tables are intact. Both worker dirs lint clean. Prose is 357 / 383 / 506 words, still well inside budget.

## New ground this round

I re-derived two things I had taken from the workers' logs last round: ZINC test diameter **12.51** and 4-hop coverage **51.8%**, recomputed with my own BFS over all 1,000 test molecules; and the GraphGPS "three ingredients" characterisation, which the paper states verbatim as "(i) positional/structural encoding, (ii) local message-passing mechanism, and (iii) global attention mechanism". Both exact.

Two things sit below the defect bar and I am not charging them: Table 3 orders its rows differently from Table 2 (cosmetic), and p1's em-dash density is at R8's symptom threshold without the length that symptom predicts.

Across both rounds I reproduced Table 1's bolded row exactly by re-running the full 30-epoch job myself, ran all four required notebook cells end to end, and recomputed every pair count, parameter count, mean, sd and half-range in the document. I have no substantive objection left.

VERDICT: PASS
